profile.headline: Experienced Lead Software Engineer with MBA and Product Management Certification
profile.summary:
As a Lead Software Engineer , I have over 14 years of experience in leading and contributing to various software development projects. I have a strong background in back and front end development, data pipelines, architecture design, and product management, with a focus on full-stack design, and recently working on AI products. I have also worked on high-level architecture decisions, including technology stack selection, security, and DevOps.

In my previous roles at Capital One and G2, I have demonstrated my ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams, collaborate closely with product leaders, and exceed goals for conversions and completion rates. I have also created an "Instrument Exploration Dashboard" using React and Scala API to empower business analysts to experiment with financial instruments. I am passionate about delivering innovative solutions that meet the needs of both users and stakeholders.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked in three different squads during my time at G2, serving as Tech Lead for the squad in charge of the Review Form at the core of G2's business. I also served as the Senior Engineer on the LABS squad - a special projects squad working directly with the founders of the company on AI and Blue Ocean initiatives.

● As the Lead Engineer for the Reviews squad, spearheaded the architecture for the redesign, and collaborated closely with Product leading to exceeding our goals for conversions and completion rates of reviews. The new design led to a 15% increase in form completion over the previous version, as well as improvements in all KPIs.
● Worked on redesigning and improving login flows for the entire site, a flow that supports 250k logins a month, including creating new one-click email and SMS based login.
● Led product development for Launchpad, a new SaaS product allowing G2 clients to self-manage features that were typically handled by CSMs, generating over $100,000 in new subscription revenue in its first year. 
● Integrated several external services via APIs for use by our customers, including granular control on email pipelines, more options for digital rewards, and even physical gifts via Sendoso.
● Created new widgets for our customers that allowed them to better integrate G2's offerings with their website, from selecting and customizing featured reviews, to collecting new review data, and displaying awards and badges.
● Worked on several AI projects in several different domains, integrating with LLMs on Retrieval Augmented Generation, Summarization, Customer Support, Customer Success, and Lead Generation. These projects required development of in-house Agentic AI tools, which are now used in production. 
● Served as Tech Lead and mentor for other Engineers throughout, including leading activities such as Code Review Sessions, Architecture Discussions and Training, book clubs, etc.

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
I was the 5th member of the engineering team for a new installment loan product offering from Capital One, working on the project beginning with initial Architecture design and later focusing on data pipelines and engineering. 

• Specialized in creating and maintaining data pipelines that serve as the backbone of the entire product, enabling communication with up- and down-stream data consumers.
• Participated in high-level architecture decisions, including technology stack selection, security, and DevOps.
• Created an "Instrument Exploration Dashboard" using React and Scala API to empower business analysts to experiment with financial instruments.
• Designed and tested prototypes for a Merchant Integration widget in React, Vue, and web components, which led to the creation of two dedicated engineering teams.
• Planned and executed the creation of several Microservice APIs and webhooks to facilitate communication between the product, external vendors, customers, and internal data consumers.
• Designed and maintained multiple AWS Lambda services in Python for processing incoming data dumps.
• Improved processes and codebases, reducing PR turnaround time by a third.
• Optimized Scala codebases to reduce compile and deployment time by approximately 40% and optimized job runtimes, resulting in EMR cluster time savings of roughly 20%.
• Served as the primary engineering contact for the Product and Corporate Data teams to design and integrate the enterprise-wide Canonical Data Model.
• Collaborated on the design and creation of ETL pipelines, including webhooks, encryption, AWS Lambda triggers, and Scala-Spark transformations in EMR, for landing data in the data lake.

positions.title: Product  Consultant & Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Gonzalez Strategy is a boutique digital Product and consulting firm I started to help businesses succeed with their new and existing online offerings. I have helped manage client projects through all phases of the product lifecycle. 

Through combining traditional business expertise with a deep knowledge of product management and full-stack development,  Gonzalez Strategy has helped clients expand their businesses and succeed in a digital world. 

As owner of Gonzalez Strategy, I have been responsible for all operations, from networking and business development, sales pitches, and creating and executing product and strategy roadmaps for our clients, as well as the development of internal and client facing products. I have had the privilege to work for some of the world's largest companies including Phillips66 & Travelers. 

•	Meet with clients and stakeholders to define project goals, outcomes, and requirements. 
•	Create software stack recommendations for client projects. 
•	Develop and deliver internal and client facing offerings in tech-stack, consisting primarily of Ruby on Rails, Postgres, JavaScript, and React.
•	Implement version control in Git and bitbucket/github. 
•	Create and deploy REST APIs built in Rails API & Node/Express.  
•	Responsible for creating and deploying Staging and Production environments on Heroku, AWS (LightSail, EC2, Elastic Beanstalk), and Windows Servers. 
•	Collaborate with SMEs, marketing, design, and engineering teams to ensure project success.

positions.title: Retained Consultant - Product Management
positions.description:
I worked with Gagen MacDonald to help them develop and manage their first ever online offering in the Gagen MacDonald Communication Institute. 

•	Collaborated with Senior Partners, BizDev, marketing, and design teams on research and ideation for Institute. 
•	Researched and recommended the software stack and served as primary contact with third party engineering teams. 
•	Developed back end systems for Institute functionality in PHP and MySQL. 
•	Developed responsive front-end in HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
•	Implemented multi-tenant functionality with isolated MySQL databases. 
•	Deployed products to Windows/Apache servers, and as well as AWS Lightsail, with AWS S3 for asset storage.  
•	Created front end quizzes in JavaScript using AJAX and PHP.
•	Implemented automation of weekly emails via SendGrid to increase engagement and fulfill reporting requirements.

positions.title: Business Consultant
positions.description:
Served as business consultant for LOJARI on a while attending MBA at the University of Texas. 

•	Facilitated the international expansion of an retailer of prescription glasses into the US market:
o	Identified under-served markets with a high saturation of potential clients for a firm expanding internationally into the US by performing data analysis and helping them launch 5 profitable branches in 3 years. 
o	Developed recruitment strategy to find and attract highly qualified candidates with a unique combination of technical and language skills necessary to serve those markets. 
o	Developed several phases of clients’ web strategy - beginning with their first ever web presence, to their first SEM efforts, and a full product management roadmap and backlog for a full ecommerce presence. 
•	Set up and worked with a legal translation firm in the El Paso borderland region including their website

•	Crafted and distributed press releases and pitch letters for online and traditional media.
